# uzu-wavetables fixture

`wt_echoes.wav` is `wt_digital/wt_echoes.wav` from
<https://github.com/tidalcycles/uzu-wavetables>, the bank the web REPL exposes
as the `wt_digital_echoes` sample alias.

It is vendored only for the `prebake-stxt` PCM comparison. License: Unlicense
(public domain). See <https://unlicense.org>.
